# Sunrise Fab Tex (Adat) & Maa Sheetla Agency
> B2B wholesale textile brokerage and manufacturer representation connecting 700+ Surat and Ahmedabad powerlooms with 500+ verified retail showroom counters across India.

## Organization Overview
Sunrise Fab Tex (Adat) and Maa Sheetla Agency operate joint wholesale textile trading desks from Surat, Gujarat. Established in 2008 in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, and expanded to Surat headquarters in 2010, the agency specializes in direct mill-rate textile brokerage, quality inspection, and consolidated dispatch logistics.

- Primary Website: https://sunrisefabtex.com
- Historical Domain: https://maasheetla.com
- Industry: Wholesale Textiles, Powerloom Brokerage, Saree & Suit Manufacturing Agency
- Coverage: 70+ Indian trade cities across 10 states (UP, Bihar, MP, Rajasthan, Delhi NCR, Punjab, Haryana, Maharashtra, West Bengal, Jharkhand)

## Specialized Trading Desks

### 1. Sunrise Fab Tex (Adat Desk)
- Focus: High-velocity wholesale commercial cartons and rapid retail inventory turns.
- Product Catalog: Dola silk sarees, printed georgettes, organza prints, daily-wear salwar suits, festive commercial catalogs.
- Packaging: Standard commercial cartons (8 to 12 pieces per box).
- URL: https://sunrisefabtex.com/sunrise-fab-tex

### 2. Maa Sheetla Agency (Curated Designer Desk)
- Focus: Premium retail showroom collections and bridal couture sourcing.
- Product Catalog: Bridal lehengas, Banarasi tissue sarees, pure silk weaves, hand-embroidered salwar suits, exclusive festive luxury edit.
- Quality Control: 100% piece-by-piece inspection floor with illuminated flaw detection tables.
- URL: https://sunrisefabtex.com/maa-sheetla

## Core Trading Floors & Addresses

### Surat Flagship HQ
- Address: H-32, Lower Ground Floor, India Market, Ring Road, Surat, Gujarat 395002
- Specialization: Mill floor liaison, piece audit tables, carton consolidation & primary transport booking.

### Kanpur Regional Office
- Address: 2nd Floor, Shiv Market, General Ganj, Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh 208001
- Specialization: UP/Bihar regional retail showroom relations and payment reconciliation.

### Ahmedabad Trading Desk (Opening 2026)
- Address: New Cloth Market, Raipur, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 380002
- Specialization: Cotton printed suitings and direct Ahmedabad mill rate cards.
